To: ada@example.com
Subject: A new device signed in to your Permaily account

A device that had not signed in to your Permaily account before has just signed in to it.

    When: 12 November 2026, 09:30 UTC
    How: with a passkey
    Browser: Firefox on Mac

If it was you, there is nothing to do.

If it was not you, sign in at app.permaily.com, open Settings, sign out the devices you do not know and remove every way of signing in that is not yours. If you cannot sign in, write to support@permaily.com.
